title: SYSTEMATIC RECTIFICATION OF LANGUAGE MODELS VIA DEAD-END ANALYSIS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model continuations on the REALTOXICITYPROMPTS benchmark using the Perspective API to measure Expected Maximum Toxicity, Probability of Toxicity, Severe Toxicity, Profanity, Threat, and Sexually Explicit content, alongside human evaluation.

Calculating the empirical probability of generated continuations exhibiting the 'identity attack' attribute (which captures identity-based bias and hate speech) using the Perspective API on a challenging subset of prompts.
